title: Data Leakage through External Entity
description: The student may inadvertently share sensitive information (e.g., student ID, assignment content) when logging in and submitting assignments, leading to potential data leakage.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store sensitive data (e.g., student IDs, assignment files) insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Data Misuse by Process
description: The Grades Portal Web App may misuse the data submitted by the student (e.g., using it for purposes other than grading), leading to privacy violations.

title: Identifier Exposure
description: The grades portal shares data that includes unique identifiers such as student ID, which can be used to identify the data subject.

title: Processing of Identified Data
description: The assignment and grading service processes identified data, which may lead to unauthorized access or misuse of personal information.

title: Non-repudiation Threat
description: The data flow may create a situation where students cannot deny their submissions or grades due to the identifiable nature of the data being transmitted.

title: Data Disclosure of Personal Information
description: The grading service stores personal data (student id, course, submission time) which could be disclosed to unauthorized parties if proper access controls are not in place.

title: Data Disclosure of Stored Assignments
description: The stored assignments in the Assignment Store may be accessed by unauthorized users, leading to potential data disclosure of personal information.

title: Processing of identified data
description: The teacher logs in and requests the queue of submissions, which involves processing identified data related to students' submissions.

title: Processing of identified data
description: The Grades Portal Web App processes the identified data received from the teacher, which may lead to unauthorized identification of students.

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The portal may not have sufficient access controls to ensure that only authorized teachers can view student submissions, leading to potential unauthorized access to sensitive student information.

title: Insecure Data Handling
description: The teacher may mishandle the data received from the portal, such as sharing it with unauthorized individuals or storing it insecurely, leading to potential data leaks.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The teacher may retain student submission data longer than necessary for educational purposes, leading to potential privacy violations.

title: Inadequate Consent
description: The teacher may not have obtained explicit consent from the student to record and share their grades and feedback, leading to a lack of legal basis for processing personal data.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store grades and feedback insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Misuse
description: The Grades Portal Web App may misuse the recorded grades and feedback, such as using them for purposes other than intended (e.g., marketing or profiling).

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The grading service may not have adequate access controls in place, allowing unauthorized users to write grade records.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The grade records database may store sensitive information without proper encryption, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The grade records may be retained longer than necessary, leading to potential misuse of personal data.

title: Identifying Data Processing
description: The system processes identified data when the student requests their own grades, which could lead to unauthorized identification if the request is intercepted or mismanaged.

title: Data Misuse at Destination
description: The Grades Portal Web App may misuse the data received from the student, such as storing it insecurely or using it for purposes other than intended.

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The portal may not have sufficient access controls in place, allowing unauthorized users to view grades and feedback meant for other students.

title: Data Retention and Disposal Issues
description: The student may not be aware of how long their grades and feedback are stored and whether they are properly disposed of after a certain period, leading to potential unauthorized access in the future.

title: Legitimate Access to Sensitive Data
description: The parent, as an external entity, has legitimate access to their child's grades, which could lead to potential misuse if the account is compromised or if the parent shares their login credentials with unauthorized individuals.

title: Data Retention and Storage Risks
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store sensitive grade data in a manner that could be accessed by unauthorized users or exposed through data breaches.

title: Legitimate Access
description: The portal may inadvertently expose sensitive information to unauthorized users if proper access controls are not implemented, allowing parents to view grades and feedback that they should not have access to.

title: Insecure Data Handling
description: The parent may mishandle or improperly store the sensitive information received from the portal, leading to potential data leaks or unauthorized access by third parties.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The parent may retain the displayed grades and feedback longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Legitimate Access to Sensitive Data
description: The School Administrator may inadvertently share sensitive data (e.g., parent-child relationships, emails) with unauthorized parties due to misconfiguration or lack of awareness.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The Grades Portal Web App may store sensitive data insecurely, leading to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Misuse by the Application
description: The Grades Portal Web App may misuse the data it receives from the School Administrator, such as using it for purposes other than intended (e.g., marketing).

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The grading service may not have adequate access controls in place, allowing unauthorized users to write account records and parent-child relationship links to the account directory.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The account directory may store sensitive account records and relationships insecurely, making them vulnerable to unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Data Misuse
description: The account directory may process or store data in a way that could lead to misuse, such as sharing sensitive information without proper consent.

title: Data Disclosure to Third Party
description: The process of sending full grade records, assignments, and account directory to the cloud hosting provider may lead to the unintended disclosure of personal data, especially if the data includes sensitive information about students.

title: Data Disclosure by Cloud Hosting Provider
description: Once the data is received by the cloud hosting provider, there is a risk that they may not adequately protect the data, leading to potential unauthorized access or further disclosure of personal data.

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The Grade Records Database may not have adequate access controls in place, allowing unauthorized users to access sensitive grade records.

title: Data Misuse
description: The Assignment & Grading Service may misuse the grade records by sharing them with unauthorized parties or using them for unintended purposes.

title: Information Leakage
description: During the data flow from the Grade Records Database to the Assignment & Grading Service, there is a risk of information leakage, such as metadata that could reveal sensitive information about students, parents, or teachers.
